scope: Escape goes back where you were, and Chrome opens once, as your own.

topics.title: The web in your own Chrome
details: When Chrome is your web browser, the web now opens in your own Chrome. You are signed in there as yourself.
Before, it sometimes used a copy of Chrome that is not signed in.
This needs the Voice Companion extension in your Chrome. Say set up Chrome to add it.

topics.title: Back where you were
details: In the Document reader, Escape now goes back to where you opened the document.
You land on the same file in the file list, or the same document in your recent documents.
Before, it went back to the Document reader menu.

topics.title: Chrome opens once
details: YouTube and the web open your Chrome only once, even if you ask again while it starts.
YouTube uses its own tab again, so extra YouTube tabs do not pile up.
Your Chrome links faster after you start Companion again.

topics.title: YouTube search
details: When you press Control+F in YouTube, the keyboard now always goes to the search box.
Before, your typing could go to Chrome instead.
